_about: Per-stack Bash checks that run without asking; init merges the matching list into permissions.allow. Exact commands only, no '*': flags and paths of lint/test tools can write files or print secrets (e.g. 'ruff check .env'). Test runners still execute project code; the real boundary is the sandbox (Phase 6).
_android: Empty on purpose: by default Android builds run in Android Studio (see the engineering skill Profile), so there are no CLI Gradle builds.
_esp32: No cargo run: with an espflash runner it flashes the board, so the guard asks.
